verdict.rationale: Namecheap publishes an official Go SDK (go-namecheap-sdk) under its own GitHub org. It documents context-aware methods for checking domain availability, registering and renewing domains, toggling the registrar lock and listing TLDs, which gives developers a first-party SDK against the API. The official Terraform provider adds a further first-party integration surface. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in languages beyond Go, depth of SDK docs beyond the README method table, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: CheckWithContext(ctx, domains...) | Check availability of one or more domains
CreateWithContext(ctx, args) | Register a new domain (charge-bearing)
GetTldListWithContext(ctx) | List all TLDs and their per-TLD API capabilities
A Terraform Provider for Namecheap domain DNS configuration.
